rationale: Damage to the policyholder's own basement structure (hardwood floor, drywall) and contents (storage boxes), regardless of source, falls squarely under property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Sam Patel returned from a work trip to find approximately two inches of water flooding the entire basement. The hardwood floor is buckled, drywall is soaked up to one foot, and stored boxes are ruined. This is a high-severity property damage claim requiring immediate on-site assessment and water mitigation.

case_facts.water_depth: approximately two inches across entire basement
case_facts.damage_description: buckled hardwood floor, soaked drywall up to one foot, ruined storage boxes

rationale: Wind damage to the roof structure of the policyholder's home is straightforward property damage to real property covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; approximately four shingles blown off. No water intrusion or secondary damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Low-severity claim, though repair cost falls below $2,500 deductible.

case_facts.description: wind damage - approximately four shingles blown off roof overhang
